name: Takayama (Nagano, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takayama village emblem in green: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Takayama, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Takayama village emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes
